advice_items.quote: Everything in my life that was a rejection was a lucky charm.
advice_items.summary_en: Treat every rejection as a lucky charm and fight back instead of accepting defeat.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把拒绝当幸运符，主动争取绝不认输

advice_items.quote: The key to really getting ahead... delegation. I'm great at hiring the right people, motivating the right people.
advice_items.summary_en: Hire the right people, motivate them deeply, and delegate rather than trying to do everything yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 招对人并充分激励与授权，不要事必躬亲

advice_items.quote: I took the deal away, which is good because everybody always wants what they can't get their hands on.
advice_items.summary_en: Create urgency by taking the deal away and read between the lines to uncover what buyers truly want.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用稀缺与紧迫感成交，洞察买家真实需求

advice_items.quote: You've got to learn to listen. People are so busy talking they miss the whole game.
advice_items.summary_en: Stop talking and listen closely in negotiations to uncover the other side's true motivation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判中少说多听，精准捕捉对方的真实动机

advice_items.quote: I almost sold my business one year for $2 million, I turned it down, but two years later I sold my business for $66 million. Timing is everything.
advice_items.summary_en: Patience and market timing can multiply an exit's value many times over for the exact same business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把握出售与交易时机，耐心等待价值最大化

advice_items.quote: I had a vision that I was going to be the queen of New York real estate... and I just believed it would happen the whole time.
advice_items.summary_en: Hold a vivid vision of your success and believe in yourself relentlessly even when others doubt you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 构建清晰成功愿景并坚定自信，用质疑激励自己

advice_items.quote: I had 22 jobs and I knew if it didn't work out I could always get my old job back.
advice_items.summary_en: Take risks knowing your downside is capped—you can always fall back on earning a living if a venture fails.
advice_items.summary_zh: 看清最坏结果并敢于冒险，失败也能重头再来

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: Residential, people need a place to live. I felt there was always a need for it.
advice_items.summary_en: Build in evergreen markets with permanent human demand, like residential housing, to weather market cycles.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择刚需常青赛道，确保经济周期中有需求

advice_items.quote: I would put it in a two-family house, live in half and get the other people paying the rent and paying off the mortgage.
advice_items.summary_en: Buy a multi-family property early, live in one unit, and let tenants' rent pay down your mortgage.
advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早买双拼住宅自住一半，用租金偿还房贷

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.quote: I got scared and I purposely failed the board. Do you know it took me eight years to catch up to the market?
advice_items.summary_en: Don't back out of buying your first property out of fear—getting in early gives you equity to trade up.
advice_items.summary_zh: 莫因恐惧错失首次买房良机，尽早上车积累筹码

advice_items.quote: I don't really believe in diversification because it doesn't work for me. I do what I do well.
advice_items.summary_en: Concentrate on what you do best rather than diversifying blindly; when investing, bet on great founders.
advice_items.summary_zh: 专注自己最擅长的领域，不必盲目分散投资

advice_items.quote: When you have a passion for your business or your product you always do well.
advice_items.summary_en: Pick a business or product you genuinely love because passion drives consistent excellence.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投身真正热爱的事业或产品，热爱驱动成功

advice_items.quote: The only difference between good people and phenomenal people is the ability to get back up.
advice_items.summary_en: Resilience—having fire in your belly and the ability to get back up after setbacks—separates phenomenal founders.
advice_items.summary_zh: 卓越创业者的核心特质是受挫后迅速爬起

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Cut Losses & Verify Asset Cash Flow
advice_items.quote: Once I got in there as the owner I found out no one had paid the rents in two years. I buried it one year later with a bulldozer.
advice_items.summary_en: Verify actual rent and cash flow before buying a property, and cut your losses decisively when an investment fails.
advice_items.summary_zh: 收购前务必核实真实现金流，亏钱项目果断止损

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.quote: When you have a good life partner, when you have a good business partner, you double your chances of success.
advice_items.summary_en: Choosing the right life and business partner is the most important decision; avoid dishonest or unhealthy partners.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对人生与商业伙伴至关重要，远离不诚实者

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Be Authentic & Leverage Your Natural Assets
advice_items.quote: You have to authentically be yourself... Everyone likes the authentic real deal. You got to be yourself, build on what you have.
advice_items.summary_en: Drop the facade, communicate in your own authentic style, and build on your natural strengths rather than school grades.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持真实自我不装腔作势，立足自身优势发展

advice_items.quote: I would sell apples on the corner and make $50,000 in the first month, build from there.
advice_items.summary_en: Start small with immediate, practical action from zero and compound your momentum from the first win.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从零起步立刻行动，哪怕街角卖苹果先赚第一桶金

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾打过22份工并做过女服务员，21岁凭1000美元借款创办纽约住宅地产公司The Corcoran Group，拒绝200万美元收购后在两年后以6600万美元现金出售公司；后通过主动写信争取重获《创智赢家》席位。
guests.role_or_title: Founder of The Corcoran Group & Shark Tank Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Sold The Corcoran Group for $66M cash in one day
guests.zero_start_advice: 脚踏实地从零起步（如在街角卖苹果先赚5万美元再滚雪球），做自己真正热爱的事、保持真实自我并善用沟通；若有积蓄尽早买两户型住宅，自住一半并以租金还贷。
